lines.text: Many learners say: I came here ago two years.
Better: I came here two years ago.
Two years ago! I came here two years ago.

data.wrong: I came here ago two years.
data.right: I came here two years ago.

native.tip: En español “hace” va delante, pero en inglés “ago” va al final: “two years ago.”
native.caption: 🙈 Error común: “I came here ago two years.” “Ago” va después del tiempo: “I came here two years ago.” ¡Escucha a Ama y repite! Practica más en la app Lexkite.
native.comment: Respuesta: “two years ago”. “Hace dos años” se dice con “ago” después del tiempo. Escribe una frase tuya con “ago” o dila en voz alta: {link}

en.tip: Learners put “ago” first, like “hace”, but English puts it last: “two years ago.”
en.caption: Common mistake: “I came here ago two years.” “Ago” goes after the time: “I came here two years ago.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
